auto_whitelist_path.description: Path to auto-whitelist database file (set to null to disable auto-whitelisting).

bayes_backend.description: Bayes storage backend (e.g., 'DB_File', 'SQLite', 'MySQL', 'PgSQL'). Set to null to disable Bayes.

bayes_path.description: File path or DSN for Bayes storage (e.g., '/var/lib/spamd/.spamassassin/bayes' for DB_File).

bind_address.description: IP address to bind the spamd daemon to (e.g., '127.0.0.1' for localhost only, or '0.0.0.0' for all interfaces).

blacklist_file.description: Path to a file containing blacklisted sender addresses (one per line). Optional.

daemonize.description: If true, runs as a background daemon; otherwise, rely on systemd for lifecycle management (recommended).

extra_args.description: Additional command-line arguments to pass to spamd (e.g., '--save-prefs', '--pidfile=/run/spamd.pid').

group.description: Unix group under which the daemon runs.

local_rules_dir.description: Directory containing local rule files (*.cf) — overrides default local rules directory.

log_packets.description: If true, logs raw message headers/lines to syslog (verbose; for debugging only).

max_children.description: Maximum number of child processes to spawn for handling concurrent requests. Note: original default shipped as 5 in config comment.

max_children_idle.description: Maximum number of idle child processes to keep warm (0 = no idle children).

pidfile.description: Path to the PID file for spamd.

port.description: TCP port on which spamd listens for client connections.

rules_dir.description: Base directory for system-wide SpamAssassin rules (override if rules installed elsewhere).

syslog_facility.description: Syslog facility to use when logging to syslog (e.g., 'mail', 'daemon', 'local0').

timeout_local.description: Timeout (seconds) for local processing (e.g., rule evaluation).

timeout_remote.description: Timeout (seconds) for remote network operations (e.g., URIBL/DNSBL lookups).

user.description: Unix user account under which the daemon runs (must have read permissions for config/rules).

whitelist_file.description: Path to a file containing whitelisted sender addresses (one per line). Optional.
